CustomField.description: Captures the type of donation the lead is interested in. This helps classify leads based on their donation preference.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the type of donation the donor wants to make. One-time Donation: A single donation made at once. Recurring Donation: A donation given on a regular schedule. Sponsorship: A donation given on a regular schedule (monthly, annually) linked to a Child, Family or Education.
CustomField.label: Donation Type
